items.title: Tom Varner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 13, 2025
items.q: George Russell was there, and then Ran Blake was there. And they were all wonderful and supportive... They were much more like that.

ctx.x: And you were working with Ran Blake as well? © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-

A little bit with Ran Blake. I first went as a Third Stream major but I realized I got along with Ran a lot better if I was not in his program. Ran– you have to do it his way. Again, bless him, but I wanted to kind of do it my way. So their quote African American music or the jazz program was at that point, for one year only Ernie Wilkins, who was great, Ernie was there, Jackie Byard of course was there, there was a composer/pianist named Tom McKinley who was there. And then the next year Jimmy Guiffre was there,…
I’m going to skip ahead a little bit.
